title: Implement bounded Saved Search and Query Asset read-only core for CAP-INV-006
goal: Deliver a provider-neutral persistence-neutral read-only Saved Search / Query Asset validation and compatibility core plus deterministic Event Search execution handoff, without performing any OPEN-013 class-2 mutation.
inputs: CAP-INV-006 canonical Saved Searches and Query Assets contract
canonical Shared Query and Search Job contracts
VERIFIED Event Search bounded runtime evidence
outputs: immutable query-asset validation and compatibility projection runtime
deterministic backend-neutral Event Search execution handoff
adversarial security and bounded local performance evidence
invariants: no canonical Saved Search or Query Asset object is invented by this bounded wave
Query remains owned by Shared Capabilities and is referenced by stable versioned identity
Search Job remains owned by Shared Capabilities
Saved View remains Shared-owned and is never merged with a Saved Search or Query Asset
Detection Rule creation/deployment/conversion remains outside this capability
OPEN-013 remains unresolved and save/share/duplicate/deprecate plus every other class-2 asset mutation is excluded
tenant scope is mandatory and cross-tenant copy is excluded
no provider, storage engine, retention policy, collaboration backend, final query dialect or final UI is selected
security_properties: caller-provided tenant and access decisions fail closed
inaccessible Query or source/field prerequisites cannot be projected as usable
compatibility diagnostics are deterministic and never synthesize missing source/field facts
execution handoff preserves original Query/version and cannot mutate the source asset
no Search Job is created or executed by the bounded runtime
acceptance_tests: no full capability completion or production-readiness claim is made

performance_budget.rationale: local asset validation compatibility projection and handoff construction are measurable without claiming storage/provider/Search Job production SLOs
metrics: local projection/handoff p95 engineering target declared before runtime

migration.rationale: bounded core is in-process, persistence-neutral and does not create a canonical Saved Search/Query Asset object

rollback.strategy: revert the current bounded task and keep downstream CAP-INV-006 tasks blocked
verification: no ledger claim is created before bounded closure
no Shared canonical object is mutated
